sql: SELECT c.command_id, c.action, c.status, left(coalesce(c.error,''),200) AS err, c.created_at, (SELECT string_agg(r.version||':'||r.status||':'||left(coalesce(r.fingerprint,''),12), ' ') FROM platform_revisions r JOIN platform_components pc ON pc.id=r.component_id WHERE pc.key='MARKET_TAXONOMY') AS tax_revs, (SELECT string_agg(e.key||':'||pc.key||':'||a.status||':'||a.action, ' | ') FROM platform_impact_actions a JOIN platform_revisions r ON r.id=a.revision_id JOIN platform_components pc ON pc.id=r.component_id JOIN experiments e ON e.id=a.experiment_id WHERE a.status NOT IN ('applied')) AS open_impacts FROM experiment_os_platform_commands c ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 3
